suite: connect wallet (start page and game) with the WizardConnect wallet SDK
note: The official WizardConnect wallet SDK applying Selene's signing rule, over a relay inside the test. Payments made with Selene itself on Mainnet are in docs/MAINNET_TRANSACTIONS.md.
passed: the start page offers "Connect wallet" beside "Play now"
connecting from the start page pairs, verifies and enters the game, with one approval that sends nothing
the new kingdom holds that wallet, and the wallet is still connected inside the game without a second approval
the balance shown is the whole wallet: the game asks for its receiving and change addresses, public keys only
the same wallet in another browser opens the same kingdom instead of a new one
inside the game, pairing a wallet verifies it at once: nothing to copy, paste or find
a wallet that refuses the check is told so, with one button to try again
a pay button without a connected wallet opens the wallet dialog, and once the wallet connects the checkout follows by itself
no page raised a script error
